data: Which two methods have a F1 score of approximately 41 between 400 and 600 authors?

In the second graph, we can see four lines representing different methods: CNN-char, SCAP, CNN-word-word-char, and CNN-word-char. We need to identify which two methods have an F1 score of approximately 41 between 400 and 600 authors.

By examining the graph, we can see that the CNN-word-word-char line and the CNN-word-char line both intersect at around 41 between 400 and 600 authors. Therefore, the two methods are CNN-word-word-char and CNN-word-char.
